reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 1 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 53 times in 100; most games like this end between 197 and 246 total points.

analyst.text: This is the second night of the Thunder-Blazers set in Portland. Oklahoma City are still missing Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Chet Holmgren, and Portland are still without Ja Morant. Portland are on a back-to-back here. The news angle is unchanged from the first game: roughly neutral, with a slight lean to the Thunder's depth.
